scripts.sync:out:todolist: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path out-todolist) { Remove-Item out-todolist -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Copy-Item out out-todolist -Recurse; if (Test-Path out-todolist\todo\index.html) { Copy-Item out-todolist\todo\index.html out-todolist\index.html -Force }"
scripts.build:clean: npm run clean:next && npm run build
scripts.deploy:main: npm run build:clean && firebase deploy --only hosting:main
scripts.deploy:lifeplan: npm run build:lifeplan && firebase deploy --project lifeplan --only hosting:lifeplan
scripts.deploy:words: npm run build:clean && firebase deploy --only hosting:words
scripts.deploy:todolist: npm run build:clean && npm run sync:out:todolist && firebase deploy --only hosting:todolist
